question: Whose attestation and consent are required before a pilot testimonial, case study, time-saved figure or benchmark record is generated, stored or shown outside the pilot organization, and what basis may its figures rest on?
decision: No external testimonial, claimed savings, case study or organizational benchmark until the organization’s authorized officer and any quoted individual give recorded written, revocable publication consent for the exact version and audience. Figures must be reproducible from measured events with a stated denominator, time window and method; delete boilerplate quotes and generated outcome numbers. Withdrawal removes active displays and triggers cache/search cleanup.
originalProposedDecision: Nothing is generated or shown outside the pilot org without written consent from an authorized officer of that org and the named speaker. Figures come only from measured usage; delete the literal default quotation.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
